controller.name: RevControl
controller.selection: minimize risk_price * upper_risk * state_amplification + queue_price * verifier_fraction * verifier_cost inside the simultaneous certified set
controller.idle_audit_channel: diagnostic only and excluded from the confidence sequence
controller.drift_action: caught base-audit state disagreement enters quarantine and recomputes the certified policy; no certified policy means all-verify

frozen_failure_ledger.effect: all policies with threshold below 0.078125 are permanently excluded for this contract
all policies with threshold below 0.0625 are permanently excluded for this contract

claim_boundaries: the policy grid is preregistered and finite; it is a numerical approximation to a continuous monotone policy family
simultaneous validity uses alpha divided across all candidate policies before outcomes are observed
a caught disagreement is repaired before state entry but does not prove that unaudited events are deterministically exact
idle audits do not enter the formal certificate without a separate known-propensity design
changing any contract fingerprint field invalidates the old certificate and starts a fail-closed epoch
performance is reported only from deployed serving runs, never from shadow-audit wall time
